title: Fix IndexedSet.pop integer-index validation
body:
## The change

Normalize explicit `IndexedSet.pop()` indices with `operator.index()` before
comparisons or mutation, matching the existing `__getitem__` behavior. Currently
`IndexedSet(range(4)).pop(3.0)` silently removes the last element, while valid
`__index__` objects are rejected or compared before normalization.

Keep the existing `None` default, integer/bool behavior, dead-slot mapping and
compaction unchanged. Regression coverage checks rejected indices leave state
intact and accepted indices agree with `list.pop()` in dense/sparse layouts.

## The backstory

I'm contributing to learn and build open-source experience, and hadn't used
boltons before this contribution. This was found during a Codex-assisted source
audit, not in production: `__getitem__` already uses the integer-index protocol,
but the last-item shortcut in `pop()` bypasses it.

## Verification

- Windows / Python 3.12.14: pristine setutils baseline 16 passed; all tests and
  doctests 678 passed, 12 subtests passed.
- New regressions on pristine code: 17 failed, 12 passed (two runs).
- Changed setutils: 45 passed; all tests and doctests: 707 passed,
  12 subtests passed.
- Upstream `tox -e py314` on Windows / Python 3.14.6 builds and installs the
  package, then passes all 707 tests/doctests (five unrelated deprecation warnings).
- Independent read-only code review: no actionable findings; independently
  repeated the same full suite and `git diff --check` successfully.
- `git diff --check` passes. No dependency or unrelated changes.

## AI assistance

- Harness/tooling: OpenAI Codex desktop, plus an independent read-only Codex reviewer.
- Model(s): GPT-5-based Codex; the exact backend model identifier is not exposed in this session.
- Original prompt(s): "继续做开源 可以做进阶一点的" ("Continue open-source contributions; a more advanced change is welcome"), followed by "继续" ("Continue"). Earlier workflow instruction: "你可以自动进行 完成每次pr之后再停止" ("You may proceed automatically; stop after completing each PR").
- Background confirmed by the contributor: "为了学习和积累开源经验，之前没用过 Boltons" ("To learn and build open-source experience; I hadn't used Boltons before").
